Q: Install 'apt-get' on a Red Hat Linux server A:

Use:

Maybe some URL is broken. Please research it.

Q: TypeError: (0 , util_1.isNullOrUndefined) is not a function using @tensorflow/tfjs-node on mac A:

I found out that version 4.22.0 of tensorflow is not compatible with node 23 due to util_1.isNullOrUndefined. This util and others were removed in node 23. Solution was to downgrade node to version 22.

Q: Use stack to build executable of a package dependency A:

Just one clarification first: Do you need that-exec only built as part of the dependency, or do you need the executable available to run via stack exec that-exec from the main project?

that-project is currently under extra-deps, not under packages. That's why Stack says: Unknown project package: that-Project Meaning, that-project is known as a dependency, but not as a project package.

stack build that-project:exe:that-exec

Stack is looking for that-project inside packages:, but it only finds . there. The Bitbucket dependenccy is in extra-deps, so Stack does not treat it as a project package component target.

Move the git dependency from extra-deps to packages:

resolver: lts-xx.y

packages:
  - .
  - git: git@bitbucket.org:workspace/that-project.git
    commit: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

with above code, this should make more sense stack build that-project:exe:that-exec now that-project is treated as a project package, not just an extra dependency.

Q: No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it. (10061) A:

Followed most answers here... none of them work.

The phone used to work from my laptop, connected wirelessly to the same wifi network/router. But now that's not an option anymore and I'm trying to connect to the phone from my desktop, it connects via LAN to the router. So while the phone is plugged into the USB I do get adb devices and daemon started successfully with port 5555, but once I unplug it and try tp connect via ip, it fails. ERROR: Could not connect to 192.168.1.222:5555. On my router I've set it up to give is 222 for the phone MAC, so the IP is not the issue.

Might the router to some isolation on LAN vs WIFI? In Windows the firewall allows both adb and the intended app scrcpy.

So strange. Will have to get a wifi adapter and see if it work that way.

Q: How can I avoid using LLMs as a software developer? A:

So if I understand you, instead of just writing my code I should embrace an unpredictable tool and to add some additional tools to the process so it will be less unpredictable? And why is this good? It's still unpredictable, only less unpredictable if those additional tools work. Yet, all this bloated infrastructure would have one purpose: to delegate parts of my thinking to something else in the hope that it will be more productive.

However, I see no value in this. I enjoy thinking. That's why I have chosen a profession where hard thinking is needed. If I was to think less, that would defeat the purpose of coding for me. And the problem of unpredictability would not even be resolved, only - hopefully - ameliorated. With the undesirable dilemma of spending more time than writing the code (which I am enjoying and which I am good at) by reviewing everything very very carefully (which I am not enjoying), or to embrace the mystery and move fast with the unpredictable output, accumulating cognitive and technical debt.

This is not desirable. Not personally, because I am not enjoying it and this is an important factor, because that's what motivates me to do it in the first place. And not professionally, because I don't want to write fast. I want to write well.

Q: prettier/prettier Replace single quote with double quote to remove escape character A:

Prettier will do all it takes to avoid escaping strings, the singleQuote rule for prettier conflicts with that of ESlint, for context, here is an excerpt from the docs:

If the number of quotes outweighs the other quote, the quote which is less used will be used to format the string - Example: "I'm double quoted" results in "I'm double quoted" and "This "example" is single quoted" results in 'This "example" is single quoted'.

At the moment, there is no walk around for that.
